learned: Modules Home shows only the modules your role may use; the red number is work waiting.
The top bar shows the business date, the clock and who is signed in; Ctrl K opens search.
Appearance & display changes text size and theme on this device only.

quiz.q: What does the red number on a module tile mean?
quiz.a: Work waiting in that module, for example arrivals to check in.

quiz.q: Which key opens the search box?
Does a text-size change affect other computers?
quiz.a: No. It belongs to this device only and is not hotel data.

learned: A reservation is confirmed with Confirm reservation or kept for two hours with Hold 2 hours.
The Calendar shows rooms against nights; an empty cell starts a booking.
A confirmed booking with money on it cannot be cancelled until the advance is refunded.

quiz.q: Which button keeps a room for a guest who has not decided?
Who may give a company a credit limit?
What must happen before a booking with an advance can be cancelled?
quiz.a: The advance must be refunded first.

learned: Guided check-in has six steps: find the reservation, verify the guest, room eligibility, confirm the tariff, advance, check in.
The ID is checked and shown masked afterwards; the purpose of visit is compulsory.
A walk-in guest is registered and checked in in one step; key cards are made from the booking.

quiz.q: How many steps does the guided check-in have?
How is the Aadhaar number shown after saving?
Where do you make a key card?
quiz.a: In the booking dialog, with the Room key button.

learned: Each room card shows the number, type, guest and the date it is busy until.
The chips Occupied, Ready, Dirty, Cleaning, Inspection and Blocked filter the board.
Only a manager blocks or unblocks a room.

quiz.q: What does Dirty mean on the board?
Can Reception block a room?
quiz.a: No. A manager or owner does it.

quiz.q: Why return the filter to All?
quiz.a: An old filter hides rooms from the next person.

learned: In-house stays lists every guest in the hotel; a room move keeps the booking and the folio.
Requests, wake-up calls and complaints are logged, assigned and timed.
Messages are queued in the Outbox and sent only to guests who gave consent; sending is simulated in the demo.

quiz.q: Which tab handles a noisy air conditioner complaint?
Who sees My guest requests?
quiz.a: The housekeeper or other staff the request is assigned to.

quiz.q: Does a queued message leave the hotel in the demo?

learned: Charges are posted from the catalogue so price and GST are right: laundry at 18 per cent, rooms at 5 per cent.
A discount is requested by the front desk and approved by the manager; at most 25 per cent of the charges.
A rate or guest change needs a reason and an approval.

quiz.q: What GST rate does laundry carry?
Who approves a service-recovery discount?
Which action changes the meal plan of a stay?
quiz.a: The Meal plan button on the folio.

learned: A table check is opened, dishes are added, the KOT is sent and the check is settled.
UPI and card settlements need a reference; room service is settled to the room folio.
A void needs a written reason and stays in the audit log.

quiz.q: What does Send KOT do?
quiz.a: It sends the kitchen order ticket to the kitchen.

quiz.q: How is a room-service dinner paid?
quiz.a: It is posted to the room folio and paid at check-out.

quiz.q: What is required to void a bill?

learned: The cashier shift shows the expected cash and the opening float; the count is compared at once.
A bank deposit needs a photo of the slip; a till transfer moves cash between tills.
A cash receipt joins the drawer total immediately; the cash book lists each account.

quiz.q: What does the Difference box show?
What is required to record a bank deposit?
quiz.a: A photo of the deposit slip.

quiz.q: Where do you see cash by account?

learned: Check-out needs every room night posted and a zero balance; the invoice number is allocated once.
A company guest's balance moves to the company receivable after a manager approves it.
After the invoice only a credit note, approved by the Owner, can reduce it.

quiz.q: Who approves a company credit of Rs 4,725?
quiz.a: A manager, because it is below Rs 10,000.

quiz.q: Which GST rate applies to a room at Rs 3,000 a night?
quiz.a: 5 per cent, split into equal CGST and SGST.

quiz.q: Who approves a credit note?

learned: The housekeeping board has four columns: To do, In progress, Awaiting inspection and Done.
An attendant ticks the whole checklist before Complete cleaning works; the supervisor inspects and releases the room.
Housekeeping reports repairs from the room card and logs found items; no hotel money is shown.

quiz.q: Who makes a room Ready after cleaning?
What happens when an inspection fails?
quiz.a: The room is returned for cleaning with a reason.

quiz.q: Does housekeeping see prices?
quiz.a: No. Housekeeping and maintenance never see hotel money.

learned: A repair request from housekeeping becomes a work order with a priority and a service-level clock.
The technician starts the work, books spare parts and completes it with a note.
The manager sees preventive plans, assets, spares, vendors and AMC contracts.

quiz.q: What turns a repair request into a tracked job?
Must a technician write a note when completing a work order?
Where are annual maintenance contracts kept?

learned: A shift checklist is ticked item by item; an item that needs proof asks for a photo or a note.
A submitted checklist cannot be changed.
The handover note tells the next shift about open issues, keys and guest notes.

quiz.q: What does Submit checklist do?
quiz.a: It locks the checklist and shows it to the manager.

quiz.q: What does an item marked photo need?
quiz.a: A photo; the demo simulates one.

quiz.q: Who reads the handover note?
quiz.a: The next shift, who marks it done.

learned: Customers 360 shows contacts, stays, money, legacy stays and requests of one person.
Show ID is logged every time; preferences and notes travel with the guest.
Duplicate profiles are flagged and never merged automatically.

quiz.q: What does Show ID record?
quiz.a: The view is logged with the user and the time.

quiz.q: Where do stays from the old Lodge software appear?
Does HCC merge duplicate guests by itself?
quiz.a: No. It only flags a Possible duplicate.

learned: The rate calendar shows the suggested and the live rate; only an approved publish changes the live rate.
The manager proposes, the Owner approves and publishes.
The tariff card is the printed price list valid from a date.

quiz.q: Who publishes new rates?
What stops a rate going too low?
Does printing the tariff card change a price?

learned: A group block holds rooms with a cut-off date; the rooming list names the guests.
Company accounts carry a credit limit; limit changes go to the Owner.
OTA bookings are accepted only when the pre-check says Can accept; the direct site has no commission.

quiz.q: What is the cut-off date of a block?
quiz.a: The last day the group may name its guests.

quiz.q: Why can an OTA booking be refused?
quiz.a: The arrival is past, the party is too big or the room is not free.

quiz.q: Which bookings carry no commission?
quiz.a: Direct bookings from the hotel website.

learned: A hall sale runs from enquiry to quotation to event: Moti Hall, Evening, 120 plates.
The quotation total was Rs 1,01,480 with 18 per cent GST; advances carry no GST.
Unfinished terms need an Owner override with a reason before the quotation can be sent.

quiz.q: Which GST rate applies to hall hire and menus?
Who can send a quotation with unfinished terms?
quiz.a: The Owner, by recording an override with a reason.

quiz.q: Is GST charged on an advance?
quiz.a: No. GST is on the tax invoice.

learned: Linen is issued to a floor pantry against a written issue; a delivery is received with a GRN.
Tabs show laundry, counts, losses, consumption, par levels and movements.
The supervisor sees quantities, never prices.

quiz.q: What records goods that arrive?
quiz.a: A goods received note, GRN, with Receive stock.

quiz.q: What triggers a reorder alert?
Where are purchase bills kept?

learned: An expense is entered with vendor, category, amount and the GST on the bill, and sent for approval.
A different person approves; only then does the money leave the drawer.
Recurring templates, budgets and the month lock belong to the Owner.

quiz.q: Who approves an expense entered by Reception?
Why is the GST on the bill recorded?
Who makes recurring templates?

learned: The staff register feeds the roster, the attendance and the payroll.
Leave is approved by someone else, and the quota is checked again at approval.
Payroll runs belong to the Owner; each employee sees only their own pay under My shifts & pay.

quiz.q: Who may approve Kavya's leave?
quiz.a: Meera, the Manager; nobody approves their own leave.

quiz.q: How many open advances can one person have?
What does an employee see under My shifts & pay?

learned: The Day closing page has seven steps from Preflight to Reopen & corrections.
The close is blocked while overdue departures, open checks or an unclosed cash shift remain.
A reopened day is closed again and the reopening is recorded.

quiz.q: How many steps does the day close have?
What blocks the close on 26 Oct in the demo?
Who can reopen a closed day?

learned: Reports show a period, can be exported to CSV or Excel and printed, and trace figures to source rows.
The Report library has search, favourites, scheduled runs and an export log.
The owner digest is yesterday on one page.

quiz.q: What logs every export?
How do you keep a report at hand?
What is the owner digest?
quiz.a: A one-page summary of the chosen business date.

learned: HCC posts vouchers from the hotel's work; manual vouchers such as a contra or an owner drawing need approval.
The accountant reads the trial balance, statements, profit and loss, balance sheet, ageing, GST and TDS.
Year end is explained, never run in a demo.

quiz.q: Who approves a manual voucher?
What does a contra do?
quiz.a: It moves money between cash and bank without income or expense.

quiz.q: Which tab shows the money owed by companies?

learned: The compliance calendar lists the obligations of the year with due dates and an Action Center.
The firm profile drives which cards apply.
The assistant answers from the hotel's own data and flags anomalies.

quiz.q: What does the Action Center show?
quiz.a: Overdue and due-soon obligations with the amount payable.

quiz.q: Does the assistant use the internet?
quiz.a: No. It uses the hotel's own data.

quiz.q: What does Go there do?
quiz.a: It opens the screen behind a flag.

learned: Users get roles; custom roles start from a base role and are adjusted per sub-function.
A sub-function can be switched off and on; the data is kept.
Master configuration, backups, system health, legacy import and the roadmap are the Owner's and Tech admin's pages.

quiz.q: Is data lost when a sub-function is switched off?
Who changes money and tax settings?
What does a dry run of the legacy import do?
quiz.a: It reports what would be loaded without changing anything.

learned: F2, F3, F4, F6, F7, F8, F10 and Alt+B open the main screens; Alt+/ lists the keys you may use.
Ctrl K searches pages and actions from anywhere.
Sign out when you leave the desk.

quiz.q: Which key opens the Room board?
Which keys list the shortcuts?
Why sign out when leaving the desk?
quiz.a: Everything is recorded under the signed-in name.

keyboard: Ctrl K - search pages and actions
Esc - close a dialog or the search box
F2 new booking, F3 arrivals, F6 room board, F7 folios, F10 cashier
passwords: Demo users: choose a name with Preview as. There are no passwords in the training build.
reference_lines.keyboard_narration: Control K opens the search box, Escape closes a dialog. F2 is a new booking, F3 arrivals, F6 the room board, F7 folios and F10 the cashier shift.
reference_lines.passwords_narration: The training build has demo users that you choose by name. There are no passwords.
